title: Alert before the OpenAI account runs out of credits
description: 2026-10-12: every bot turn on development failed because the OpenAI account behind /chatticus/development/thin-turn/openai-api-key had no credits (HTTP 429 insufficient_quota, credit_balance_exhausted). PR 512 logs provider_failed lines and shows a specific reason. Still needed: an alert (or a daily check against the billing or usage API) so the account is topped up before bots stop; consider an auto-recharge setting on the account.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Triage 2026-10-14 (kept open): Not done on origin/develop: no CloudWatch alarm or metric filter on provider_failed or insufficient_quota exists in infra/lib (only the Cognito federation-flood alarm), and no billing-usage check exists. PR 512 provides the log lines and the specific reason shown to the user. Left: an alarm on the provider_failed insufficient_quota log line (cheap, in CDK) and/or a daily usage-API check, plus auto-recharge on the account (an owner action outside the repo).

comments.author: home
comments.text: Investigation 2026-10-16. Owner-only (OpenAI dashboard, account owner): usage limits, billing alerts and auto-recharge are set in the OpenAI dashboard; agents cannot set them. Do this first: enable auto-recharge and a billing/usage email alert there. Code-side already present: the model gateway enforces a monthly model spend ceiling (default 25.00 USD, env CHATTICUS_MONTHLY_MODEL_SPEND_CEILING_USD, conversation/src/ledger/model-spend.ts) from the cost index. That protects our budget but does not tell us the OpenAI balance is low; our ledger knows spend, not the vendor credit balance. Key parameters (SSM, names only): /chatticus/development/thin-turn/openai-api-key (modified 2026-10-01, development account); /chatticus/staging/thin-turn/openai-api-key (modified 2026-10-15) and /chatticus/production/thin-turn/openai-api-key (modified 2026-10-11), both visible in the production-profile account. Whether the three hold distinct keys cannot be determined without reading values, which was not done; owner to confirm in the OpenAI dashboard (API keys list, last-used) that each environment has its own key or project. PROPOSAL (not implemented), smallest design: a scheduled Lambda (EventBridge daily, existing rollup pattern) reads the month-to-date and trailing-24h priced model spend per environment via DynamoModelSpendReader/readCostRows, publishes custom CloudWatch metrics ModelSpendUsd24h and ModelSpendMonthToDateUsd, and a CloudWatch alarm on each (thresholds from CDK props, e.g. 24h > 10 USD, month > 80 percent of the model ceiling) notifies the existing SNS alert topic used by the AWS spend alarm. Add a second alarm on the gateway provider_failed log metric filter for insufficient_quota (HTTP 429) so a drained account pages immediately instead of waiting for the daily check. Gherkin first in features/, then CDK in infra/. Caveat: this alerts on our spend rate and on the failure itself, not on remaining OpenAI credit.

right_now_summary: The owner must enable OpenAI billing alerts and auto-recharge; balance monitoring is not built.
